title: From Process Models to Composable Agentic Workflows: Combining BPMN, Agents and Enterprise Knowledge
abstract: arXiv:2611.13196v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM-based agents can reason, use tools and collaborate. However, coordinating increasingly complex agentic applications becomes difficult to understand, monitor and improve. Decisions distributed across prompts, tool calls and application logic make workflows implicit. We introduce **Recursive Capability Composition**, enabling agents to execute business processes and expose them as reusable Agentic Tools.   This paper presents a BPMN-based approach to Agentic Workflows, combining explicit orchestration with autonomous reasoning. SemTalk BPMN models are transformed into executable workflows using a LangGraph/Pregel runtime. Agentic Tasks introduce LLM reasoning at selected activities, while conventional BPMN controls process flows, deterministic decisions, system interactions and human approvals. translated_title: 从流程模型到可组合的智能体工作流：结合BPMN、智能体与企业知识
translated_abstract: 基于LLM的智能体能够进行推理、使用工具并相互协作。然而，协调日益复杂的智能体应用变得难以理解、监控和改进。分散在提示词、工具调用和应用逻辑中的决策使得工作流变得隐式化。我们提出了**递归能力组合**方法，使智能体能够执行业务流程，并将其作为可重用的智能体工具向外暴露。本文提出了一种基于BPMN的智能体工作流方法，将显式编排与自主推理相结合。SemTalk BPMN模型通过LangGraph/Pregel运行时被转换为可执行的工作流。智能体任务在选定的活动中引入LLM推理，而传统的BPMN则控制流程流转、确定性决策、系统交互和人工审批。智能体参与者为智能体行为或其他可执行流程提供可重用的接口。BPMN编排使多智能体系统（摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: 本文提出基于BPMN的智能体工作流方法，通过“递归能力组合”将BPMN流程模型转换为可执行工作流，用传统BPMN控制确定性的流程、决策与人工审批，仅在选定环节引入LLM推理，从而让智能体能够执行业务流程并将其封装为可重用的智能体工具。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Recursive Capability Composition, a BPMN-based approach that transforms process models into executable Agentic Workflows—combining deterministic BPMN orchestration with LLM reasoning at selected tasks—so that agents can execute business processes and expose them as reusable Agentic Tools.
